description: This file defines a mock class 'PersistentStoreImplementationMock' used for unit testing. It inherits from multiple interfaces related to a persistence store system and utilizes Google Mock to create mock implementations of the interface methods.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementationMock
classes.description: A mock class for the interfaces IStore, IStore2, IStoreCache, IStoreInspector, and IStoreLimit, used in unit testing scenarios to simulate store behavior.

methods.name: ~PersistentStoreImplementationMock
methods.description: Destructor for the mock class, defaulted.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration method for notifications, with overloads for different notification types.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregister method for notifications.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Mocks setting a value in the store, overloaded for both IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a value from the store, for both IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Mocks deletion of a specific key, for both IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Mocks deletion of a namespace, for both IStore and IStore2 interfaces.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Mocks retrieving keys within a scope for inspection.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieving all namespaces within a scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Mocks retrieving storage sizes for namespaces.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks setting the storage limit for a namespace.
